# Subscription Fees

Subscription fees are recurring or one-time charges that are **not** tied to individual usage events. Paygent supports three fee families — each can have **multiple named line items** on a single agent or plan.

| Fee type | Billing | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| **Setup fee** | One-time (first eligible invoice) | Onboarding, integration, training |
| **Platform fee** | Recurring (Monthly / Quarterly / Annually) | Base platform access, support, bundled credits |
| **Seat-based fee** | Recurring per seat | Per-user licensing, team seats |

Configure fees on **Agents → Step 3: Pricing** or on any **Plan**.

---

## Multiple fees per agent

You are not limited to one setup fee, one platform fee, or one seat fee. Use **Add fee** to stack named line items:

```
```

Each fee has an optional **name** that appears as the invoice line description. Unnamed fees default to “Setup Fee”, “Platform Fee”, or “Seat-Based Fee” with a numeric suffix when duplicates exist.

---

## Setup fee

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| **Price** | One-time amount |
| **Currency** | Fee currency (defaults to org currency) |
| **Billing timing** | When the fee is recognized relative to the billing period |

Setup fees are charged **once** per order line when the setup-fee window first applies. Paygent deduplicates by order, agent, fee name, and invoice date — you won’t double-charge the same setup fee.

---

## Platform fee

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| **Price** | Recurring base amount |
| **Billing frequency** | Monthly, Quarterly, or Annually |
| **Billing timing** | Advance (start of period) or Arrears (end of period) |
| **Credit benefits** | Optional bundled credits per period — see [Credits & Wallets](https://docs.withpaygent.com/documentation/introduction/credits-and-wallets) |

Platform fees appear on every billing cycle for active orders. Multiple platform fees invoice as separate line items.

### Skip platform fee when setup is charged

Enable **Skip platform fee when setup fee is charged on the same invoice** when your commercial model replaces the first month’s platform fee with a setup charge (common in enterprise onboarding).

When a setup fee is invoiced in a cycle, platform fees for that cycle are skipped automatically.

---

## Seat-based fee

| Setting | Description |
|---|---|
| **Price** | Per-seat rate (or tiered — see below) |
| **Billing frequency** | Monthly, Quarterly, or Annually |
| **Billing type** | FLAT, VOLUME, or GRADUATED |
| **Minimum commitment** | Minimum billable seats |
| **Included usage** | Free seats before metering starts |
| **Tiers** | Volume/graduated seat pricing |

Seat count is supplied on the **order line** when creating the order. Invoice quantity = configured seats × per-seat rate (respecting tiers and minimums).

**Example — volume tiers:**

| Seats | Price per seat |
|---|---|
| 1–9 | $29 |
| 10–49 | $24 |
| 50+ | $19 |

---

## Billing timing: advance vs arrears

| Timing | When fee is invoiced |
|---|---|
| **Advance** (default) | Start of the billing period |
| **Arrears** | End of the billing period, after usage for that period |

Set timing at the **agent level** (default for all fees) or **per fee** (overrides agent default). Arrears billing is useful when platform or seat fees should align with usage totals on the same invoice.

---

## How fees appear on invoices

On each billing run for an active order, Paygent generates line items:

1. **Setup fees** — if not yet charged for this order/agent/fee name
2. **Platform fees** — unless skipped due to setup-fee rule
3. **Seat-based fees** — quantity from order line seat count
4. **Activity / outcome usage** — from tracked indicators
5. **External costs** — from `send_external_cost` events
6. **Taxes** — if configured on the order

---

## Combining fee types

Most AI SaaS products use a hybrid stack:

```
```

Configure the subscription fees on the agent or plan, activity pricing on indicators, taxes on the order, then create an order with seat count and activate it.

---

## Dashboard setup checklist

- ✓ Enable each fee type you need and click **Add fee** for additional line items
- ✓ Name fees clearly — names appear on customer invoices
- ✓ Set billing frequency and timing per fee
- ✓ Add credit benefits on platform fees if selling prepaid credits
- ✓ Configure seat tiers if pricing varies by team size
- ✓ Create an order with seat count and activate

**Related:** [Plans](https://docs.withpaygent.com/documentation/introduction/plans) · [Subscriptions](https://docs.withpaygent.com/documentation/introduction/subscriptions) · [Orders & Invoicing](https://docs.withpaygent.com/documentation/introduction/orders-and-invoicing)
